\section*{1. Analysis problems}
Find the domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{x^2-1}$ and sketch it. The domain is
\[ \{x\in\mathbf{R} : |x|\ge 1\}, \qquad f(x)\ge 0. \]
\textcolor{red}{Red ink}, \textcolor{blue}{blue ink} and \textcolor{green!50!black}{green ink}
keep their hue on dark pages.

\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=1.1]
  \fill[blue!20] (0,0) rectangle (4,3);
  \draw[thick,->] (-0.2,0) -- (4.3,0) node[right]{$x$};
  \draw[thick,->] (0,-0.2) -- (0,3.3) node[above]{$y$};
  \draw[very thick,red,domain=0:4,smooth] plot (\x,{0.15*\x*\x+0.3});
